versions.changelog: x402 payer: pay any x402 API from a prepaid Rozo balance (USDC on Base payment leg; top up with USDT/USDC on Solana, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Stellar or BTC Lightning). New subcommands: x402 topup, x402 pay, x402 balance. Solana payment leg is coming later.
Pay OpenRouter or any Coinbase invoice from the crypto you already hold. Orders now carry attribution.client. README and description rewritten.

Recommends the keyless default path and the stellar-agent-wallet skill (shawnmuggle/stellar-agentic-wallet) over configuring .env hot-wallet keys, demoting the .env template to unattended EVM/Solana automation with a dedicated low-balance hot wallet, across SKILL.md and all eight localized docs; declares the skill's permissions (network endpoints, env vars, filesystem access, signing cap) in SKILL.md metadata, answering the ClawHub audit's 13 Credential Access findings and Lp3.

0.1.9: removes all child_process usage — the tracked-.env refusal check now reads .git/index directly (v2/v3 parser, checksum-verified, fail-closed on split-index / env-selected repos / unsupported formats). This clears the dangerous_exec static findings. Adds docs/security-audit-notes.md explaining the remaining env_credential_access findings: they are the disclosed optional hot-wallet mode with its code-level mitigations (env-only keys, output scrubbing, $1,100 cap, double confirmation).
0.1.8: corrects the listing display name (0.1.7 went out as 'Rcs Pub' due to a publish-tool folder-name default). Same code as 0.1.7.

0.1.7: user-level .env location is ~/.rozo-checkout/.env (a generic ~/.env is never read); NO_KEY_SOURCE lists the paths searched; Mode A/B kept as internal vocabulary — agents say who sends the money and what the user must do; Base USDC runs the normal flow like any other chain.
Countdown expiry with local time, stable order-reuse wording, visible balance-check result
CLI progress narration + Mode B key preflight; esbuild security bump
